We're releasing new Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs with Unsloth Dynamic V3.1! Expect 5-10% accuracy gains on the same size vs UD3 and other quants.

We do better vs GSQ-RCO, Exllama-v3 on the pareto frontier for Terminal Bench, DeepSWE and more. Quants above 2-bit to 6-bit are updated.
